title: feat: allow xiaotian1171 to publish community models
author: gggff123

gist.headline: A new gardener gets keys
gist.blurb: A community model publisher has been added to the hive’s trusted garden crew. More open-model pollen can now make its way into the catalog.
gist.summary: Added xiaotian1171 to the GitHub authorization list for publishing community models.
gist.impact: This lets xiaotian1171 publish community models through the existing contribution flow, expanding the pool of models the community can share.
gist.visual_concept: Polli welcomes a new community gardener at a cozy model garden: a GitHub-shaped access key opens a small greenhouse where labeled model-seed packets can be published. Use code-plants and a retro terminal to make the authorization and publishing flow visible, with Polli offering the key rather than dominating the scene.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener hat, handing a GitHub-shaped key to a friendly new gardener beside a small greenhouse full of model-seed packets and code-plants; a retro terminal glows lime green (#ecf874) with simple pixel text: 'PUBLISH'. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
